entry.title: Creating a BW workspace using a composite provider
entry.content:
I want to create a BW workspace using a composite provider that joins two ADSOs, but I encountered an issue.  I am working in BW4 and want to use a composite provider as my main provider in the workspace settings of RSWSP. The composite provider is a join of two ADSOs.  I have tried multiple ways to get around this.  First was to create a Union node in the composite directly above a Join and assign it to the main provider of RSWSP.  Only then can you see it in the Central Providers section.  Second was to do a Joule suggested, and that was to drag in the Composite provider in the Central Providers section along with the two ADSOs, but the composite provider is not available unless it is in the Settings for main provider section first.  Even there, you cannot add additional ADSOs once the Settings for main provider has been established.  Please see attached.

 

I should not have to create a new model.  The Composite model already exists.  I am just trying to use what is already built, not reconstruct what is already built.  We need this tool so we can allow our Power Users to use the Workspace Designer Query functionality.  We would assign this capability as a self-service capability for power users, that could help generate queries for our infoconsumber base.  Giving them access to Eclipse is not the ideal state. 

 

Steps;

Original Scenario cannot be used as a main provider on the Setting Tab of RSWSP

Workaround #1, tried to put a Union as the top of the new Scenario.

Workspace designer does allow it in the Settings for main provider:

However, when looking at this in central providers, it remains in Error:

Attempting work around #2, tried to add ADSOs after establishing Settings for main provider.

Please also note that there is no “Composite” provider to select from in the Central Providers area.

entry.content:
We have created an SDA flow from Sap Analytics Cloud system to load data in BW4.

Up until now we have loaded data using FULL load, but now it's becoming more and more needed a delta load approach since the volume of data is becoming too big (about 200 million records for one scenario). entry.title: 0FI_ACDOCA_10の項目拡張後、BW/4HANA側でDataSourceを有効化できない。
entry.content:
■問合せ内容    
S/4HANA標準DataSource「0FI_ACDOCA_10」の抽出構造を拡張し、 カスタム項目を3項目追加しました。    
S/4HANA側ではDataSourceに追加項目が反映され、RSA3による抽出テストでも 追加した3項目の値を正常に取得できています。    
 一方、接続先のBW/4HANAシステムにてDataSourceの変更内容を確認後、    
 DataSource「0FI_ACDOCA_10」を有効化すると、以下のエラーが発生し、有効化できません。     
現在、BW Modeling Tools上では対象DataSourceが無効状態になっています
    
■エラー内容    
BW/4HANA側のRSDSおよびBW Modeling Toolsの両方で有効化を試しましたが、    
いずれも同様のエラーが発生します。    
    
エラー1：アクセスメソッド ODP が存在しません    
    メッセージ番号：RSDS001
エラー2：データソース 0FI_ACDOCA_10 H1DODPC310 の有効化時にエラーが発生しました。    
    
エラー3：データソース 0FI_ACDOCA_10 H1DODPC310 の有効バージョンへの再設定時にエラーが発生しました。    
    メッセージ番号：RSO410
    
診断：    データソース 0FI_ACDOCA_10 H1DODPC310 の有効化時に
    エラーが発生しました。この有効化の前に、有効バージョンが
    すでに登録されています。
    
システム応答：    データソース 0FI_ACDOCA_10 H1DODPC310 を以前の有効バージョンに
    リセットすることができませんでした。生成済みオブジェクトは
    旧有効バージョンに対応していないため、無効にリセットされます。
    
手順：    データソース 0FI_ACDOCA_10 H1DODPC310 の古い有効バージョンは
    今後使用できません。有効化エラーの原因を排除し、新しく
    データソース 0FI_ACDOCA_10 H1DODPC310 を有効化してください。

entry.title: Can we replicate SAP Datasphere Views Back to BW/4HANA?
entry.content:
Hi Experts,

I understand that SAP provides the Data Product Generator (DPG) to replicate BW/4HANA objects (such as ADSOs) to SAP Datasphere.

My question is whether there is a supported approach to move or replicate data in the opposite direction, specifically from SAP Datasphere back to BW/4HANA.

In our project, we are gradually rebuilding existing BW/4HANA data flows in Datasphere. During the transition period, some downstream BW/4HANA processes may still depend on data that has already been modeled or transformed in Datasphere. Therefore, we are exploring whether data from a Datasphere view or model can be loaded back into BW/4HANA for temporary use until the migration is complete.

Has anyone implemented a similar scenario? If so:

  • What options are available to load data from Datasphere into BW/4HANA?
  • Are there any SAP-recommended approaches or best practices?
  • What are the main limitations or considerations (performance, governance, connectivity, etc.)?

Any insights or recommendations would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you in advance!

Best regards,
Phani

entry.title: PaPM UM OData connection test failed with Metadata for XXX cannot be retrieved
entry.content:
Hi Experts,

I'm currently setting up a BW OData connection to PaPM UM using OData V2, and I've run into an issue during the connection test in PaPM UM.

I've completed the following checks:

  • Cloud Connector has been configured and is showing as reachable.
  • The BTP Destination has been created and is also reachable.
  • I tested the BW OData service in Gateway Client, and the execution returns HTTP 200 without errors. I can also see data being returned from the Entity Set successfully.

However, when creating the connection in PaPM UM and clicking Test Connection, I receive the following error:


"Metadata for destination XXX and service path sap/opu/odata/sap/Z_C_ZGHG_CONSUME_CDS cannot be retrieved."


The issue is that the error details in UM seem to contain only this message, so I'm not sure where to continue troubleshooting.

 
I've performed similar OData integrations from an OP system to PAPM UM in other environments before, and they worked successfully.
 
However, in my current system, I configured the internal host in Cloud Connector using an IP address (192.xxx.x.x) rather than the actual hostname. (I didn't use actual host name because it will lead to cloud connector error like java.net.unknownhostexception: myhostname: name or service unknown.) I just checked the Cloud Connector logs and found the following entries. I'm not sure whether this is merely noise or if it is actually the reason why the PaPM OData connection is failing:
03:30:42 TLSSocketFactory → peer alternative names: [192.x.x.x, myhostname]
03:32:28 tunnel-client → Peer host '192.x.x.x' does not match certificate DNS names [myhostname]

Has anyone encountered a similar issue before? Do you have any suggestions on how to resolve it and get the connection working successfully?
 
Any tips or guidance would be highly appreciated! Thank you in advance.
SAP Profitability and Performance Management SAP BW/4HANA Cloud Connector

entry.title: BPC ADSO in Planning Session shows request “completed with errors” in RSMNG – how to clear the error
entry.content:
Hello SAP BW/4HANA experts,

I need help with a BPC-related ADSO where a request shows “completed with errors” in RSMNG, even though the data is present and the ADSO is working correctly in Planning Session.

Environment:

SAP BW/4HANA [version]

ADSO is a BPC model (planning-enabled ADSO)

RSOADSO-PLANNING_MODE = 'X' (correct for this ADSO)

Real-time behavior in RSMNG shows Planning Session – this is the intended state for this BPC model

Data is written via BPC planning, not via BW DTP or process chain

Relevant tables: RSPMPROCESS, RSPMREQUEST, RSPMLOG, RSPMTRACE

Problem description:

In RSMNG, there is a data request that shows “completed with errors” .

When I double-click the error, only the PROCESS_TSN is displayed — there is no actual error text.

In table RSPMPROCESS, there is a process with:

PROCESS_TYPE = 'PLAN'

PROCESS_STATUS = 'R'
This process was not triggered by a process chain, and the PLAN process  is about three months old.

RSPMREQUEST contains record with PROCESS_STATUS = 'GG'  and LAST_PROCESS_TSN WITH the error process tsn for this ADSO.

I have not deleted or modified this 'R' record yet.

In the log fields, the combined message appears as:
RSPMTRACE,100,0,2256,G,6


However, table RSPMTRACE is empty.

Data loads (BPC planning writes) still work, and subsequent process chain loads also complete normally.

My goal is:

Clear the “completed with errors” status in RSMNG

Make the data with error info can be activated.

Remove the inconsistent 'R' status so monitoring no longer shows an error

Questions:

What does the message RSPMTRACE,100,0,2256,G,6 mean?

Why is there a request showing “completed with errors” but no error details?

Is it safe to delete the old RSPMPROCESS PLAN record with status 'R'? Or should it be changed to 'G' instead?

Will deleting or changing this record affect the BPC planning data already written to the ADSO?

Is there a standard SAP note or repair program for this kind of RSPM status inconsistency in a BPC planning ADSO?

How can I make the request activatable without losing the already-written BPC planning data?

Has anyone seen this behavior where BPC planning data writes successfully but the RSPM PLAN process remains in status 'R' and RSMNG shows “completed with errors”?

Any guidance would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks.

entry.title: How Can We Predict CTS Import Errors Before Production Import?
entry.content:
Hello Experts,

 

We are currently working on a BW project.

Our transport process is controlled by a separate program ( developed by management team ),

so we do not have authorization to perform imports directly.

 

To reduce the risk, we run pre-checks such as /SDF/TRCHECK before submitting transport requests.

However, it seems that these checks cannot identify all issues that may occur during the actual import process.

 

We have also tried using the STMS Test Import.

However, even for transport requests that already failed due to missing dependent objects,

Test Import still returned a positive result. so we cannot trust it.

 

As developers, it is often difficult to predict how a transport will behave in production before the actual import.

Is there any way to simulate an import under conditions that are as close as possible to the real production import process?

Any advice, tools, or best practices would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you.
